req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-032 requires that every response body under /players/ includes the squadNumber field. The primary endpoint under test is GET /players/{id}. We need: (1) a positive test confirming squadNumber is present and correct for a known player, (2) a negative test confirming a 404 for a non-existent UUID (error pathway), (3) a boundary test using the first (squad 1) and last (squad 26) seeded players to verify squadNumber at the edges of the dataset, (4) an additional EP test verifying the exact integer value of squadNumber in the JSON response body, and (5) a DT test verifying that the camelCase alias 'squadNumber' (not snake_case 'squad_number') is the key present in the JSON response, catching field-name mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_positive
preconditions: Player with id=97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 and squadNumber=1 exists
trace: R-PLAYER-032: squadNumber field must appear on every /players/ response body
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_positive():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'

tests.name: test_squad_number_field_name_is_camel_case_not_snake_case
preconditions: Player with id=e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6 and squadNumber=10 exists
actions: Inspect JSON response keys for camelCase vs snake_case
expected: Key 'squadNumber' (camelCase) is present in JSON body
Key 'squad_number' (snake_case) is NOT present in JSON body
trace: R-PLAYER-032: field must be named squadNumber (camelCase alias from PlayerResponseModel)

def test_squad_number_field_name_is_camel_case_not_snake_case():
